page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores utilizing an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 16.0 GB of system memory, which translates to 2.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the processor delivers modest performance. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng place the instance in the bottom 25% tier. Similarly, Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores rank in the bottom 10% and bottom 25% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show a split profile: small-block cached read operations are weak, falling in the bottom 25%, whereas large-block uncached read and write operations achieve average performance in the middle 50% tier.

The instance exhibits performance limitations in specific tasks, with single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10% and database operations like Redis SET and Passmark database tests ranking in the bottom 25%. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the instance achieves average performance during prompt processing and text generation with a small 135M parameter model, but drops to the bottom 10% when handling a medium 7B model. Given the dedicated CPU cores but lower memory-to-CPU ratio and modest overall benchmark results, this instance is suitable for basic compute tasks, light web serving, and development workloads that do not require high memory density or rapid disk I/O.

It is configured with 16.0 GB of RAM, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, and lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps. Performance benchmarks indicate that the instance generally sits in the lower tiers, with stress-ng and Geekbench scores placing it in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. However, uncached large-block memory bandwidth and small-model LLM inference speeds reach average levels. Given these characteristics, the instance is best suited for light compute workloads, basic web serving, and software compilation tasks that do not demand high memory capacity or intensive storage performance.
